questions.question: Which CSS property is used to specify the font family?
questions.explanation: The 'font-family' property is used to specify the font family (typeface) for text. For example: font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;

questions.question: Which CSS property is used to make text bold?
questions.explanation: The 'font-weight' property is used to make text bold. Common values include 'bold' or numeric values like '700'.

questions.question: Which CSS property is used to make text italic?
questions.explanation: The 'font-style' property is used to make text italic. The value 'italic' creates italic text.

questions.question: Which CSS property is used to align text?
questions.explanation: The 'text-align' property is used to align text. Common values include 'left' (default), 'right', 'center', and 'justify'.

questions.question: Which CSS property controls the space between letters?
questions.explanation: The 'letter-spacing' property controls the space between letters. For example: letter-spacing: 1.5em;

questions.question: Which CSS property controls the space between lines of text?
questions.explanation: The 'line-height' property controls the space between lines of text. For example: line-height: 120%;

questions.question: Which CSS property controls the space between words?
questions.explanation: The 'word-spacing' property controls the space between words. For example: word-spacing: 5px;

questions.question: According to the CSS Fonts resource, what unit is recommended for font-size in responsive design?
questions.explanation: For responsive design, it's recommended to use 'em' units for font-size. The example shows: font-size: 1.1em;
The 'color' property controls the font color (text color). In this example, #999 is a light gray color for the text.

questions.question: What is the default value for text-align?
questions.explanation: The default value for text-align is 'left'. Text is left-aligned by default unless you specify otherwise.

questions.question: Which of the following is a valid font-family declaration?
questions.explanation: Font families with spaces should be in quotes, and it's good practice to provide fallbacks. 'font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;' provides the preferred font and fallbacks.

questions.question: What is a common resource for finding web fonts mentioned in the CSS Fonts resource?
questions.explanation: Google Fonts (fonts.google.com) is mentioned in the CSS Fonts resource as a font resource. It provides free web fonts that can be easily integrated into websites.

questions.question: What is Font Awesome used for?
questions.explanation: Font Awesome (fontawesome.com/icons) is mentioned in the CSS Fonts resource as an icon resource. It's a popular icon library that uses fonts to display icons.
